title: The Business Leader Podcast — Sir Richard Harpin hosts Eric Ries: 'Anybody who has found a way to make money without creating value is corrupting the moral logic of our economic system'
summary: The Business Leader Podcast — UK business publication (38K YouTube subs; sponsored by RBC Wealth Management) hosted by Sir Richard Harpin (founder of Homeserve; £4B exit) — releases a 62-minute conversation with Eric on Incorruptible. Frames the book as 'Silicon Valley's innovation bible, Part Two': how successful startups get ground down by corporate governance norms and best practices, why financial gravity affects even visionary founders, and Ries's blueprint for retaining integrity through long-term growth.
blockquote: Anybody who has found a way to make money without creating value is corrupting the moral logic of our economic system.
blockquote_source: Eric Ries on The Business Leader Podcast with Sir Richard Harpin
attribution_title: Host, The Business Leader Podcast · Founder, Homeserve (£4B exit)
